messages.content: "你能幫我做一些計算嗎？首先，我有兩個向量，[1, 2, 3]和[4, 5, 6]，我需要計算它們之間的餘弦相似度。我希望結果保留兩位小數。然後，我有兩個數組，[7, 8, 9]和[10, 11, 12]，我需要計算它們之間的皮爾森相關係數。之後，我又有兩個數組，[13, 14, 15]和[16, 17, 18]，我需要計算它們之間的斯皮爾曼相關係數。最後，我還有兩個向量，[19, 20, 21]和[22, 23, 24]，我需要計算它們之間的餘弦相似度，但這次我希望結果保留三位小數。"

function.name: cosine_similarity_calculate
function.description: Calculate the cosine similarity between two vectors. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

vector1.description: The first vector for calculating cosine similarity.

vector2.description: The second vector for calculating cosine similarity.

rounding.description: Optional: The number of decimals to round off the result. Default 0

function.name: correlation_calculate
function.description: Calculate the correlation coefficient between two arrays of numbers. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

type.description: Optional: The type of correlation coefficient to calculate. Default is 'pearson'.
